summary: The proof establishes the stated bound for every permitted rational affine roof, including zero heights and degenerate lifts. The accepted census and complete midpoint certificate justify the exhaustive division into vertical pairs and the unique distinct base pair at each nonvertex. The floor pair-sum bounds follow correctly from the affine roof identity, and conditions 1-3 are both necessary and sufficient for the all-center reflection bound. Under these necessary conditions, each base parity class of size two contributes at most four to cardinality plus singleton parity classes, and each class of size three contributes at most six. The four classes of each size therefore give the claimed upper bound of forty. Boundary checks include the zero roof and the constant height-one roof, the latter attaining forty with maximum reflection count three. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
